task.title: Reject control-bearing authentication tokens
task.objective: Reject bearer tokens containing ASCII controls or DEL before transcript or transport side effects
acceptance_criteria: C0 controls and DEL make a runtime token invalid
Invalid tokens fail before transcript mutation or network setup
Printable Unicode tokens remain valid and one validated credential value is reused

attempts.summary: Added focused control-token and pre-mutation boundary regressions
attempts.diagnostic: Two focused tests failed because control-bearing bearer tokens were accepted

attempts.summary: Validated one bounded token value and reused it during synchronous request setup

outcome.summary: Bearer credentials now reject control characters before observable side effects while preserving printable Unicode

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1092

lessons: Credential validation must precede transcript mutation and transport setup
Reuse the validated credential value to avoid a token-provider time-of-check/time-of-use gap
